resources.string: Set an app password (12+ characters). It protects saved credentials, chats and keys.
Passwords must match and contain at least 12 characters.
Cannot unlock: wrong password or damaged storage.
Your chats live here. Add a key, configure your account, then open a chat. Swipe left or right to switch chats.
Create or import an encryption key first.
Leave the phrase empty to generate a random 256-bit secret. For web compatibility, enter the same phrase and chat name in web.html.
Enter a key name and a phrase of at least 12 characters (or leave it empty).
This QR contains the secret key. Share only with intended chat participants.
This key is assigned to a chat. Remove the chat first.
Use a chat name of 3–80 characters. Equal names and keys form a single tab.
Cannot decrypt: different key or damaged message.
Remove this chat and its cached history from this device? Server messages are retained.
Includes credentials, all saved chats, keys and downloaded message history. Use a strong backup password. Unsynced server history is not included.
Restore replaces the local account, chats and keys. Export a backup first if needed.
Cannot restore: wrong password or invalid backup.
No keys yet. Generate a key or scan a QR.
Too many attempts. Try again in %1$d s.
The app and notebook passwords must differ.
Own messages on the right, others on the left
Settings are saved even when offline. Changing the address or username creates a new server entry and disables the old one, preserving its history and pending deliveries.
Enter a name, HTTPS address, username and password.
Leave all proxy fields empty for a direct connection. Otherwise enter a host and port 1–65535. Authentication requires both a username and password (1–255 UTF-8 bytes).
Invalid SOCKS5 host, port or credentials.
SOCKS5 refused authentication. Check proxy credentials.
Cannot connect through SOCKS5. Check its address, port and server access.
Server unavailable or TLS/network error. Other servers continue working.
Message saved to the encrypted delivery queue.
Could not save synchronization data. Check available storage.
Choose a password different from the app password. Lock the app and enter this password in the single login field to open the notebook. Notebook contents cannot be opened from chat settings.
Notes are encrypted and saved automatically, including when the app is locked.
Could not save the note. Check storage and note size (title up to 200 characters, text up to 1 million).
Sign-in failed or session revoked. Check this server username/password and reconnect.
